text:
Avery: Hey folks — quick holiday thread! :tada: Office potluck this Friday (Dec 22) at 2pm in the kitchen. Sign up below with what you’re bringing. Also bring your pets? We’ll do a tiny ‘bring your pet pic’ slideshow for those who can’t make it. :)

Sam: I’ll bring my famous mac and cheese (vegan option too). Also attaching a pic of Moose the corgi. 🐶

Priya: Count me in for salad and napkins. Can’t wait to meet Moose!

Jon: I can bring drinks — seltzer + one bottle of something festive. Also FYI, I’ll be remote that day but will drop my dish at the dropbox by 1:30.

Marta: I’ll bring cookies. Is there a fridge space for a cranberry tart?

Lila: I can do a tiny playlist for background music — any requests? Holiday classics or more chill vibes?

Noah: Classic + chill mix sounds perfect. I’ll bring some paper plates and disposable cutlery.

Avery: Awesome. Small logistics note: the office is on a reduced schedule next week — HolidayBot, can you post the official closure dates?

HolidayBot: Heads-up: Redwood offices closed Dec 25–26 for the holidays. Limited on-call coverage 12/24 and 12/31. (See HR notice)

Avery: Thanks! Quick potluck signup (copy/paste into a message if you want to add):
```
Sam: mac & cheese (vegan option)
Priya: mixed greens salad
Marta: cranberry cookies
Noah: plates & cutlery
Jon: seltzer + festive bottle
Avery: charcuterie board
Lila: holiday playlist
```

Priya: Love the pet slideshow idea — here’s Bruno (my cat) :heart:

Sam: posting Moose pic in #random-photos in a sec :dog: :thumbsup:

Marta: Can someone remind me of where the toaster oven is? I might warm up cookies for crispiness.

Noah: It's in the kitchenette cabinet under the coffee maker (labelled).

Avery: One more tiny poll — Secret Santa or low-key gift shelf? React with :gift: for Secret Santa, :stocking: for gift shelf.

Priya: :gift:

Jon: :stocking:

Lila: :gift: :santa:

Sam: :stocking: (less pressure)

Avery: Locking poll at 3pm tomorrow. Thanks everyone — excited to celebrate. If you can’t make it but want to drop a pet pic, toss it here!
